content.title: Brunswick: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: METTAWA, Ill. (AP) — Brunswick Corp. (BC) on Thursday reported fourth-quarter net income of $18.7 million, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier. The average estimate of seven analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was also for earnings of 58 cents per share.
